free_text: The 68-year-old male presents with a rising PSA (5.5 ng/mL) and moderate LUTS (IPSS 13/35). MRI shows a PI-RADS 4 lesion (cT1c) in the right peripheral zone apex. The biopsy confirmed adenocarcinoma with Gleason 4+3 (ISUP Grade Group 3). Given the patient's comorbidities and the findings, individual treatment benefit and preferences require clinical review.
